verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of a public IRS page where a founder can check the status of a filing, application, or case. The MeF status page covers system deployment status for transmitters, not an individual filing. The Business Tax Account and transcript items are bare titles with no status-lookup content, and online account access sits behind ID.me sign-in rather than public pages.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
